mentions.name: sfw.tools
mentions.description: This site gathers handy tools that get used once in a while into one place, without ads or clutter, and is optimized for usability rather than impressions. Users can suggest additional tools to be added.
mentions.problem: Occasionally needed tools are scattered and often buried behind ad-laden websites; this puts them together in one clean, ad-free place.
mentions.source_excerpt:
All those things I use once in a while, I put them on one place without ads or bs. Optimized for usability, not impressions or whatever.

https://sfw.tools
mentions.author: moralestapia
